nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: ADR-051 parallel image batch. Inputs: requests_json (array of {placeholder_id,prompt,size,aspect,caption,alt,block_order,reference_urls[]} — reference_urls added by the resolver, ADR-052 Block 2); impact (all images in a run share it); concurrency_cap (from config.image_concurrency_cap, passed by the caller); + passthrough clickup_task_id/triggered_by/invocation_type/caller_user_id/process_type.

nodes.name: Lookup Routing
nodes.notes: ADR-051: primary image routing row for the shared impact (modality fixed to 'image'). Reuses Invoke Model's exact query incl. the image_gen_params resolution join and __default__ fallback. onError=continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so a transient DB miss still flows; Resolve Batch Requests falls back to the safe gemini floor model if no image row.

parameters.query:
select r.litellm_model, r.temperature, r.max_tokens, r.nudge,
       r.price_in_usd_per_1k, r.price_out_usd_per_1k, r.fallback_price_per_unit, r.impact,
       p.resolution
from model_routing r
left join image_gen_params p on p.impact = r.impact
where r.impact in ($1, '__default__') and r.modality = 'image' and r.active = true
order by (r.impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

nodes.name: Get Image Key
nodes.notes: ADR-051: reads the dedicated, revocable LiteLLM image key from Supabase Vault via the SECURITY DEFINER getter public.get_litellm_image_key() (migration 032). Code nodes can't use credentials and $env/$vars are unavailable here, so a credentialed Postgres read is how the batch obtains a secret. NO onError: a missing key/secret throws -> Error Handler CRITICAL (auth broken = real failure, not a silent degrade).

nodes.name: Lookup Image Tiers
nodes.notes: ADR-051: all active real-tier image rows = the PRICE MAP for the fallback tier (its model comes from Resolve Lower Tier (v1)) and for the gemini->gpt-image-2 upgrade. No tier ORDERING lives here. onError=continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData: no rows -> no fallback prices (images still run on the primary).

parameters.query:
select impact, litellm_model, price_in_usd_per_1k, price_out_usd_per_1k, fallback_price_per_unit
from model_routing
where modality = 'image' and active = true
  and impact in ('Niski','Średni','Wysoki','Krytycznie ważne');

nodes.name: Resolve Batch Requests
nodes.notes: ADR-051: inline port of Invoke Model's Resolve Routing image logic, applied PER request (ADR-045): size from requested_size > aspect > 1024 default; gemini->gpt-image-2 shape-intent upgrade (explicit size OR non-1:1 aspect on a non-gpt tier, with a Polish resolution_note); gpt size validate/snap; tier->quality. Model selection + ALL tier prices are DB-sourced (Lookup Routing primary row; Lookup Image Tiers price map; Resolve Lower Tier v1 owns the step-down). The only literals are irreducible DB-down last-resorts (gemini safety net when Lookup Routing returns no image row; gpt upgrade prices when the tier map is empty). ADR-052 Block 3: emits use_reference/ref_transport/reference_urls per request — NO reference-driven model-forcing (tier model stands); ref_transport classifies by the chosen provider (openai/gpt-image-2 -> 'edits', gemini -> 'gemini'). Block 4 consumes these; a no-reference request gets use_reference:false and is otherwise untouched. ADR-052 Block 4b: also emits ref_leg ('edits' when use_reference && the routed model is gpt-image-2, else 'plain') so Route Edits can split the multipart edit leg off without model-forcing.

nodes.name: Fire Images Concurrently
nodes.notes: ADR-051 core: fires all N LiteLLM image calls via Promise.all over a BOUNDED promise pool (max concurrency_cap in flight; default 4). Per image: try the resolved primary model; on non-2xx OR 2xx-with-empty b64_json retry once with the one-tier-below model (or re-send primary at the floor tier). Failures are caught per-image (never throw -> never CRITICAL). max_in_flight emitted for cap verification. Auth = Vault image key from Get Image Key (throws if missing). ADR-052 Block 4a: adds self-contained callImageReference(req) (inputs prompt/primary_model/reference_urls/ref_transport; reused verbatim by the future generate_image tool handler, ADR-053/054). use_reference -> callImageReference: ref_transport 'gemini' = POST /v1/chat/completions with a text part + one image_url part per reference URL, image parsed from choices[0].message.images[0].image_url.url with the data: prefix stripped (Block 0 proven); ADR-052 Block 4b: ref_transport 'edits' (gpt-image-2) is handled UPSTREAM — the multipart /v1/images/edits call runs in the Run gpt-image-2 Edit sub-workflow and its base64 rides on req.edit_b64; worker() uses it directly (used_reference:true) or, if the edit leg failed (edit_b64 null), fails soft to plain text-to-image (degrade_reason 'reference-unanchored'). On any reference failure/unsupported + time remaining -> fail soft to plain callImage text-to-image, degrade_reason 'reference-unanchored' or 'reference-edit-unsupported' (WARN in Assemble, never CRITICAL). Soft-deadline/Promise.race/notGenerated unchanged; used_reference tracked.

nodes.name: Explode Results
nodes.notes: ADR-051: per-image cost layering mirroring Invoke Model's Normalize Model Result image branch (header>0 -> usd_cost=header; else token-math via filled price_out; else per-image floor). Emits the Log Model Run input shape per image, carrying the image payload fields forward for Assemble. cost_header_missing recorded for the warnings surface. ADR-052 Block 4a: also carries used_reference + degrade_reason through to Assemble for the reference-degrade WARNs.

nodes.name: Call Log Model Run
nodes.notes: ADR-051: reuse the shared agent_runs writer UNCHANGED (cost stays unified), mode=each -> one agent_runs row per image, priced by the served model. onError=continueRegularOutput so a log failure (Log Model Run has its own WARN) never breaks the batch return. Returns {cost_pln_total} per image; Assemble zips it back by index.

nodes.name: Assemble Batch Output
nodes.notes: SOLE TERMINAL (sub-workflow return determinism): exactly one incoming connection. Zips Explode Results (image data, ordered) with Call Log Model Run output (cost_pln_total, ordered, mode=each preserves order) by index. Emits one per-image object mirroring Invoke Model's Shape Output {placeholder_id, success, b64_json, model, cost_pln, size, degraded, resolution_note, caption, alt} + a per-image warnings[]. The caller (Image Resolver) aggregates warnings; execute-llm-call's Has Warnings? then fires the WARN. Never CRITICAL here. ADR-052 Block 4a: emits image-batch/reference-unanchored (gemini reference call failed) and image-batch/reference-edit-unsupported (gpt-image-2 edits leg not yet wired, Block 4b) when a reference request degraded to plain text-to-image; exposes used_reference on the per-image output. ADR-052 Block 4b: the gpt-image-2 edits leg is now wired (Run gpt-image-2 Edit), so reference-edit-unsupported is no longer reachable from worker() — the handler is retained as a harmless backstop; edits now succeed (used_reference) or degrade to reference-unanchored.

nodes.name: Resolve Lower Tier Image
nodes.notes: ADR-051: the SOLE owner of the one-tier-below step-down rule (Resolve Lower Tier v1, GNO6ZsIcSpvYUJDq), called ONCE for the run's shared impact — runs on a single item (after Get Image Key) so it neither re-serializes the parallel calls nor fans out. Returns the below image tier's {impact, litellm_model} (or {floor:true} at Niski). Resolve Batch Requests reads that impact and looks the tier's prices up in Lookup Image Tiers. onError=continueRegularOutput: a resolver failure -> no fallback (images still fire on the primary), never blocks or CRITICALs.

nodes.name: Route Edits
nodes.notes: ADR-052 Block 4b: split the gpt-image-2 reference (edits) leg off the batch. Routes each resolved request by $json.ref_leg: 'edits' (output 0) -> the dedicated multipart edit sub-workflow; everything else falls to the fallback (output 1, 'plain') -> straight to the Merge. Edits can't ride the concurrent Code node (multipart needs an HTTP Request node), so they detour through Run gpt-image-2 Edit and rejoin before Fire. Safe with empty branches (the edits output is usually empty — top-tier references are rare).

nodes.name: Run gpt-image-2 Edit
nodes.notes: ADR-052 Block 4b: calls Generate Image Edit gpt-image-2 (v1) (ScjmV2qQpvww3sWm) ONCE PER edits-routed request (mode=each; top-tier references are rare, so sequential before the concurrent bulk is fine — Block 0). Passes placeholder_id (echoed for correlation), prompt, the gpt-valid size, and the FIRST resolved reference_url. Returns {placeholder_id, ok, b64_json, header_cost}. onError=continueRegularOutput: a sub-workflow throw (Vault key missing) passes the input item through (no b64) so Attach Edit b64 -> edit_b64 null -> Fire fails soft to plain text-to-image; the Vault-key CRITICAL still surfaces from Fire's own key check.

nodes.name: Attach Edit b64
nodes.notes: ADR-052 Block 4b: single incoming connection (from Run gpt-image-2 Edit, mode=each). Joins each edit result back to its full resolved request from Resolve Batch Requests by placeholder_id (executeWorkflow replaces the item, so the sub-workflow echoes placeholder_id), and attaches edit_b64 (data[0].b64_json or null on failure) + edit_header_cost. The full request + edit fields flow into the Merge; Fire Images Concurrently then consumes edit_b64 (used_reference) or fails soft to plain gen if null. On a sub-workflow THROW (Vault key), executeWorkflow onError passes the INPUT item through (no b64) -> edit_b64 null -> fail soft. Never throws.

nodes.name: Merge Edit Leg
nodes.notes: ADR-052 Block 4b: append the plain branch (Route Edits fallback, input 0) and the edits branch (Attach Edit b64, input 1) back into ONE stream for Fire Images Concurrently. Safe with empty branches (the edits branch is usually empty). Fire keeps a single incoming connection; the return path Fire -> Explode -> Call Log -> Assemble Batch Output (sole terminal) stays branch-free.
